page.overview:
Who is Esdras?

Esdras was a male Sith Lord of the Sith Empire living during the Cold War. He was the master of Hiran Bessiker, whom in 3643 BBY Esdras sent to Balmorra to recover a Holocron unearthed by the Republic.

Esdras is mentioned in Star Wars: The Old Republic during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Balmorra.

Category:Males Category:Sith Lords of the reconstituted Sith Empire
